payload.report_excerpt: It is worth stating carefully, because the framing matters for how the result should be applied downstream, that reranking a first-stage candidate set with a cross-encoder improves top-five recall relative to bi-encoder retrieval alone, at a cost in latency that scales with the size of the candidate set being reranked [Nadia, 2022].
payload.source_excerpt: Cross-encoder reranking of the top 100 bi-encoder candidates improves recall@5 by 7.8 points and adds 190ms of median latency; reranking the top 20 adds 41ms for a 4.1 point gain.
